name: Potent Divination
body:
Your detection spells are faster and stronger than normal.

Prerequisites: Ability to cast a detection spell

Benefit: When you cast a detection spell (any spell beginning with the word detect), you learn in 1 round what you would normally learn in 3 rounds and the range increases by 60 ft..
